title: Kubernetes: Debug Running Pods
text: For a pod in CrashLoopBackOff, inspect kubectl describe pod and kubectl logs --previous, restart count, container exit state, health probes and events. The repeated restarts indicate a container is failing after it starts.

title: Kubernetes: Assign Memory Resources
text: An OOMKilled container may have exceeded its memory limit. Examine limits and actual memory consumption. Exit code 137 can occur with a SIGKILL and needs supporting termination evidence.

title: Kubernetes: Images
text: ImagePullBackOff may mean a wrong image tag, unavailable registry, credentials issue, or image pull restriction. Use pod events to identify the exact image retrieval failure.
